description: Golden fixture for decision reading (issue #617): run the reader over every document and compare against `expected`. Grouped per city → per administrative body; `otherDocuments` holds a city's documents that belong to no tracked body. `verified: true` labels are document truth confirmed by manual review; `verified: false` labels are trusted but unreviewed. Documents with kind `other` are not deliberative session decisions and must read as meetingDate null. Body notes describe publishing behaviour on Diavgeia. Coverage: all 11 supported Greek municipalities are represented; bodies a city has that the fixture deliberately does not cover are listed under bodiesNotCovered with the reason. Demo cities outside the Diavgeia realm (nis, rennes, vouli) are out of scope.

bodies.name: Δημοτική Επιτροπή
bodies.notes: Diavgeia's protocolNumber field is a filing protocol, distinct from the decision number. The Diavgeia subject line starts with the decision number, in the form «<n>-<year> Απόφαση Δημοτικής Επιτροπής <title>». The number is therefore available from the search metadata, before the document is read. Use it to check the number the reader takes from page 1.

bodies.name: Δημοτικό Συμβούλιο
bodies.notes: Diavgeia's protocolNumber field is a filing protocol, distinct from the decision number. The protocol number is often absent from the document itself. The Diavgeia subject line starts with the decision number, in the form «Α.Δ.Σ. <n>/<year> «<title>»» or «<n>-<year> Απόφαση Δημοτικού Συμβουλίου <title>». The number is therefore available from the search metadata, before the document is read. Across 138 documents of both bodies, 137 carried a number in the subject line.

bodies.name: Δημοτική Επιτροπή
bodies.notes: Diavgeia's protocolNumber field usually carries the decision number, with occasional true filing protocols. Page 1 opens «ΑΠΟΣΠΑΣΜΑ από το πρακτικό της υπ' αρ. <n>ης/<year> Συνεδρίασης», so the body numbers its sittings per year. The decision number follows as «Αρ. Απόφασης <n>/<year>». The session date is written «σήμερα την <n>η του μήνα <Month> του έτους <year>», which puts «του μήνα» and «του έτους» between the parts of the date. Decision numbers restart each year, so a number identifies a decision only together with its year.

bodies.name: Δημοτικό Συμβούλιο
bodies.notes: Diavgeia's protocolNumber field carries the decision number. Page 1 opens «ΑΠΟΣΠΑΣΜΑ από το πρακτικό της υπ' αρ. <n>ης/<year> Συνεδρίασης», so the body numbers its sittings per year. The decision number follows as «Αρ. Απόφασης <n>/<year>». The session date is written «σήμερα την <n>η του μήνα <Month> του έτους <year>», which puts «του μήνα» and «του έτους» between the parts of the date. Decision numbers restart each year, so a number identifies a decision only together with its year. Special sittings (ειδικές συνεδριάσεις) carry a second number series that also restarts at 1 each year, in parallel with the ordinary one. It covers the budget vote, the management report and the election of the presidency, so «1/2026» is not the first decision of 2026.

bodies.name: Δημοτική Επιτροπή
bodies.notes: Diavgeia's protocolNumber field is a filing protocol, distinct from the decision number. Page 1 prints the decision number as ΑΡΙΘΜ. ΑΠΟΦ: <n>/<year>. The ΑΠΟΣΠΑΣΜΑ line names the sitting as «της <n>ης τακτικής συνεδρίασης» or «της <n>ης έκτακτης συνεδρίασης». The two layouts are otherwise identical, and the session date follows «σήμερα την» in both.

bodies.name: Δημοτικό Συμβούλιο
bodies.notes: Diavgeia's protocolNumber field is a filing protocol, distinct from the decision number. Page 1 prints «Αρ. Απόφασης: <n>» and «ΑΡΙΘΜΟΣ ΠΡΑΚΤΙΚΟΥ <n>». The πρακτικό number resets each year and is not the decision number. The opening sentence reads «συνεδρίασε δια ζώσης σήμερα την <date>» for a normal sitting. It reads «συνεδρίασε Διά Περιφοράς σήμερα την <date>», or «συνεδρίασε σε Διά Περιφοράς συνεδρίαση σήμερα την <date>», when the body decides by written circulation. The date keeps the same position in every variant.

documents.notes: Page 1 carries four date strings and only the first is the session date: «σήμερα την 26η Μαρτίου 2025» is the sitting, while 27 Μαρτίου and 29η Μαρτίου (twice) appear in the decision body as the date of the event being approved. All three decoys fall in the same month as the session, so a reader cannot separate them by proximity alone. The session was held Διά Περιφοράς, which changes the wording of the opening sentence but not the position of the date.
